full_judgment: 4. Md. Shafiqul Alam (P.W.1) a sub inspector of police amended the prosecution case. According to the prosecution version acting on after off that a gang of dacoits was taking preparation at Laskarpur rail gate for committing dacoity to vehicle. P.W.1 along with P.Ws.5,7 and other constable approached towards the place of occurrence on 16.03.99  at about 8p.m. On the way they noticed that the dacoits wee approaching towards heard cities from the place of occurrence when is on the bridge people were saying dakat dakat” police detained 7/8 dacoits from a tempo. Thereafter the police sat in Taher Ulla’s (P.W.3) shop and prepare a seizure list. The police told them that the arm and ammunition were recovered from the dacoits. They proved their signature in the seizure list.
